checked_obligation: Verify the definition and enumeration of horizontal and vertical potential triples and the claim that maximality forces every potential triple to contain a removed stamp.
reason: In each row, a consecutive three-stamp block has n-2 possible starting positions when n≥3 and none when n=1 or 2, giving n·max(n-2,0) horizontal triples; the same argument applies to columns. Thus the stated total is correct. If any potential triple contained no removed stamp, its three adjacent stamps would remain available as another block, contradicting that the configuration is blocked. The listed group-theoretic rules are inapplicable and unnecessary.
